source: 一手：clone 仓库 + 本地实跑 + 源码静态核对

C1_lineage.self_mark_quote: A+ 只描述清单完成度，不是生产可用结论；第三方 36 PoC 测出 26 缺陷，该自评不覆盖任何一条
C1_lineage.third_party_audit: 外部审计附 36 可执行 PoC，26 条可复现，4 条可打挂进程
C1_lineage.fix_chain: CHANGELOG 0.5.0: 26 条全部不复现，21 项改写为反向回归，测试 130→151
C1_lineage.lineage_verdict: 三份自带审计均为实现方自评；其中一份已自我否定并引用第三方 PoC 证据；自评与第三方结论不可混同，同构不等于独立验证

C2_claim_vs_code.tools_definition: src/actions/registry.ts 定义 9 个 action，TOOL_DEFINITIONS 由 toolDefinitions() 生成，运行时实测 length=9

claims.code: src/util/paths.ts:123 escapes configured roots 拒绝；runner.ts:407 Fail closed 不再把 --force 交 caller

claims.claim: 权限策略集中不被 prompt 绕过
claims.code: cli.ts:89 防 smuggle --force; buildArgs 由 tier 决定参数

claims.claim: 环境 allowlist 非 host 复制
claims.code: cli.ts:176 旧版 {...process.env} 泄露 secret 已修

C2_claim_vs_code.note: 自查一处疑似不一致（tools.ts switch 只 4 case vs README 9 工具），判据自审确认是检查方法错误：switch 只特判需特殊序列化的 4 个，其余走通用路径；真实定义在 registry.ts

negative_tests_sample: B0-8 event ring bounded in BYTES not just count
B1-1 execute on non-git workspace REFUSED not run in place
B2-4 Agent Card does not disclose absolute host paths
B2-7 rate limiting per client so one caller cannot starve rest
unsafePushUrl: private/metadata blocked BUT legitimate public domains NOT falsely blocked
A2A malformed artifact path returns 400 and does NOT crash
C3_test_authenticity.verdict: 测试为可证伪负面测试（含双重断言防过度拦截），非 happy-path 自证；第三方 PoC 已反向改写为回归

C4_security_falsifiability.argv_injection: cli.ts:105 注释 prompt '--force' 曾变 flag 的漏洞已修；spawn 不开 shell (CVE-2024-27980) 注释 line 156
C4_security_falsifiability.path_whitelist: paths.ts assertWorkspaceAllowed + symlink escape 检测 (line 123)
C4_security_falsifiability.env_allowlist: B1-8 test: environment is allowlist not host copy; explicit passthrough wins over sensitive filter
C4_security_falsifiability.process_tree_kill: B1-7 test: taskkill exit codes classified; cancel kills whole tree (README)
C4_security_falsifiability.private_url_block: B1-5 CGNAT/IPv4-mapped; unsafePushUrl IPv6 loopback/ULA blocked but public NOT false-blocked
C4_security_falsifiability.capability_honesty: CI 注释: gRPC 不声明就不跑，65 grpc cases skipped 而非假绿
C4_security_falsifiability.verdict: 安全声明有对抗测试与代码双重支撑，可证伪性高

C5_reproduction.lint: pass (2 warnings, 0 errors: no-explicit-any in cursor/parse.ts)
C5_reproduction.ci: Linux + Windows matrix; npm audit --omit=dev; official A2A TCK pinned commit; Agent Card scan; e2e real-run; reproducible release SHA256 verify; PowerShell parse gate; least-privilege token
C5_reproduction.verdict: 完整复现：install→typecheck→lint→build→test 全通过，CI 覆盖全面且有多道治理门禁

C6_absorption_candidates.gate_test: 能否拦：只测拦截不测误杀 → flag 测试不充分 → 是
